decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (01a Received 10/05/2011) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The detached outbuilding shall only be used for purposes ancillary to the enjoyment of the single-family dwellinghouse known as 10 Wilton Road, Hounslow and for no other purpose.
description: Erection of an outbuilding to be used as a gym/store in the rear garden
